{{Quote|I've arranged for you to go help a local farmer named Pol Handerin. He's having some trouble on his farm.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper|Jasper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />}}
'''Pol Handerin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Oh, hello. You must be the one Lt. Jasper was saying would come to help me. Boy, I sure hope you're able to. My farm is really beginning to suffer.|Pol Handerin, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />}}
Pol Handerin lived in a [[Pol Handerin's farm|farm]] on the outskirts of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the Galactic Civil War. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the farmer got into serious trouble because of wild creatures and bandits that plagued his farm. Handerin thus went to seek help from the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] dispatched a recruit to help the farmer. Pol Handerin first tasked the CorSec agent to hunt and eliminate a pack of enraged [[carrion spat]]s that did a lot of damage. The CorSec agent succeed and even killed the pack leader [[Gravefeather]]. Handerin then asked the CorSec agent to deal with a group of criminals, the [[Nedgarr Bandits]], who damaged crops and stole grain. The mission was once again successful. The CorSec agent managed to recover the stolen grain and eliminate several bandits, including their leader [[Trae Nedgarr]], during an assault on the [[Nedgarr Bandits hideout|Nedgarr Bandits Hideout]]. Handerin was really thankful for the help he received and that solved all his problems. When the CorSec agent mentioned his will to work for the government, Pol Handerin eagerly proposed to introduce the CorSec agent to his cousin, [[Gallura Handerin]], a government aide in the [[Coronet Capitol]].<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pol Handerin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Pol Handerin was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]", on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />
